Question_text: The new football boot is being developed.

Roles: directors, managers, supervisors, employees, inter-relationships

Parts.part_text: The new football boot is being developed. Identify and explain four stages of the future product life cycle of the new football boot.

Consider why each of the following departments will be important to the success of the new football boots. Justify your answer using information in the case. Production: Marketing: Human Resources: Finance:

Sub_topic: Increasing efficiency: automation, technology, labour skills
Features, benefits, limitations: job, batch, flow production

Parts.part_text: KSS production workers are highly skilled in doing just one task on the production line. Identify and explain two advantages and two disadvantages of workers being skilled in just one task.

The Production manager believes that labour-intensive methods are better than capital-intensive methods of production for the new football boots. Do you agree with him? Justify your answer using appropriate calculations from the information provided in Appendix 1.

Sub_topic: Benefits, limitations of methods, including IT

Parts.part_text: Good communication is important to Emmanuel. He has the following information to communicate. • All employees are to receive a wage increase. • There has been an error with a delivery of some supplies. Identify a suitable method of communication for each situation. Explain why each method is suitable.

Labour costs are much lower in other countries. Many sports shoe manufacturers produce in those countries. Consider the advantages and the disadvantages to KSS of manufacturing its football boots in another country. Do you think KSS should move manufacturing to another country? Justify your answer.

Sub_topic: Brand image: impact on sales, loyalty
Pricing methods: cost plus, competitive, penetration, skimming, promotional

Parts.part_text: Identify and explain two benefits to KSS of creating a brand image for its new football boot.

Emmanuel needs to decide a pricing strategy for the new football boot. Consider price skimming, cost-plus pricing and competitive pricing. Which do you think is the best pricing strategy for Emmanuel to use? Justify your answer using information in Appendix 3.

Sub_topic: Opportunities of foreign markets: growth potential
Problems: cultural differences, lack of knowledge
Impact of legal controls: misleading promotion, faulty goods

Parts.part_text: The new football boot will be exported to many different countries. Identify and explain four possible problems KSS may have when exporting the new football boot.
Emmanuel has already chosen Option 1. Was it the right decision to choose Option 1 rather than Option 2? Justify your answer by considering the advantages and disadvantages of each option.
